headline: Genetically Modified Crops Generated $197.5 Billion in Gross Benefits Over 30 Years in Argentina
summary: The CEO Group estimated that GMO crops generated cumulative gross economic benefits of approximately $197.5 billion in Argentina between 1996 and 2025.
why: Agricultural biotechnology adoption drives productivity gains, foreign exchange earnings, and input cost adjustments for agribusinesses.

impacts.name: Agribusiness
impacts.why: Long-term productivity gains support the valuation and export capacity of agricultural enterprises.
